claim: Swift is still operating; it re-enters on 1 January 2027 (status_timeline)

suggestion.from: The mission has been operating for over 20 years, contributing significantly to our understanding of black hole formation and neutron star mergers.
suggestion.to: Over more than 20 years it has transformed our understanding of black hole formation and neutron star mergers. With its orbit decaying faster than expected, a commercial mission to boost it was called off in August 2026, and Swift is expected to re-enter the atmosphere by the end of the year.
